title: Vanilla+ | Extended
description: The Extended version of the Z+ Modpack! More Features, more fun!
body:
Focus: Significant expansion of vanilla possibilities through thematically appropriate, in-depth mods.

The vanilla feel with expanded horizons.

“Extended” goes one step further: it integrates many QoL mods that significantly improve the gaming experience.

**Disclaimer**
We recommend not playing with this modpack on public servers such as Hypixel, as it contains mods that can lead to a permanent ban (e.g., Freecam)!
